task_title: Contain Floor 2 den bosses before relocking doors

plan_review.notes: Chosen containment design retained. Resolved: encounter start now refuses to relock when the referenced boss is missing or lacks Enemy/Health; added a stale-boss regression. Added a separate unstick regression for the nearest-passable-outside-den fallback. Recorded spawn positions are already used only after den containment; the fallback remains deterministic. Added explicit bossEntityExists telemetry to distinguish missing from defeated.

independent_grade.notes: The change correctly implements containment for Floor 2 den bosses to prevent softlocks by relocating them to their spawn tiles before the doors relock. The diff is tightly scoped, containing only the necessary gameplay logic and telemetry diagnostics. It includes comprehensive integration tests covering all critical edge cases, such as stray bosses, missing entities, and unstick fallback scenarios. The code strictly complies with determinism rules and layer boundaries, resulting in a robust and highly maintainable solution.
